title: Verity Study redesign
question: A dark-only, conversation-first workspace. Confirm this direction or steer it before implementation.

options.label: Focused study workspace
options.thesis: One navigation column, one readable conversation, and evidence only when requested.
options.lineage: Research desks and document-navigation interfaces, translated into a precise dark workspace.
options.viewport: A 256px sidebar combines navigation and compact history; a single main toolbar leads into a wide reading column and a bottom composer. Fresh launch shows a clean new conversation.
options.risk: Restraint needs exceptionally precise spacing and contrast to avoid looking merely plain.

raised.raise: History and library rows become compact, consistently aligned, and scannable.
Answer and evidence retain a clear relationship rather than becoming unrelated panels.
Every view has one clear task heading and one primary action.
Repeated rows receive identical dimensions and state treatment.
Comparisons use consistent typography and aligned source labels.
Diagnostics are rigorously secondary to readable study content.

options.label: Dense module grid
options.thesis: Pack conversations and evidence into a dense module index.
options.viewport: A tiled index surrounds the conversation.
options.risk: Too much information competes with reading.
options.case: Lower student identification and lower explanation clarity than the focused workspace.

options.label: Mirrored evidence score
options.thesis: Mirror answer segments and evidence along a central reading spine.
options.viewport: Answer and evidence remain simultaneously visible.
options.risk: An unfamiliar reading order adds cognitive load.
options.case: Lower familiarity and lower task clarity for ordinary study questions.

options.label: Task wayfinding
options.thesis: Guide each study task through large directional bands.
options.viewport: A prominent next-task banner leads the screen.
options.risk: Wayfinding overwhelms the material being studied.
options.case: Lower audience identification and lower content clarity for long reading sessions.
options.kept: One clear primary task per view.

options.label: Study roster
options.thesis: Organize study sessions as a finite visual roster.
options.viewport: A session grid precedes the conversation.
options.risk: A catalog-like opening delays asking a question.
options.case: Lower identification and clarity than the requested conversation-first surface.

options.label: Source folio
options.thesis: Present sources as a sequential set of registered study plates.
options.viewport: Source comparisons lead before the conversation.
options.risk: Prioritizes source browsing over the explicitly requested chat workflow.
options.case: Lower student identification and lower product clarity for conversation-first use.

options.label: Data field
options.thesis: Expose the retrieval system as a high-density data field.
options.risk: Diagnostics compete with understanding and movement distracts.
options.case: Lower audience identification and lower study clarity.
options.kept: A strict hierarchy that contains diagnostics.

canonCard.label: Conventional chat layout
canonCard.thesis: A familiar dark chat layout with no distinctive structural changes.
canonCard.viewport: The expected sidebar-and-chat arrangement with consistent controls.
canonCard.risk: Familiar but visually indistinguishable from other chat products.
